name: rosetta-averages-median
code:
use default

median(values: Collections.Iterable[double]) -> double is
    let ordered = values |> sort() |> collect()

    assert ordered.count > 0 else "the median of no values is not defined"

    let middle = ordered.count / 2

    return
        if ordered.count % 2 == 1 then
            ordered[middle]
        else
            (ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle]) / 2.0
        fi
si

write_line("{median([4.1, 5.6, 7.2, 1.7, 9.3, 4.4, 3.2])}")
write_line("{median([4.1, 7.2, 1.7, 9.3, 4.4, 3.2])}")
